commands:
set -euo pipefail
SHA=d1d7b9ec21d2d8e4bcb293559c5133013455c882
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
PORT_S3="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"
source scripts/source_idf.sh
PROBE="$(python -m esptool --port "$PORT_S3" chip_id 2>&1)"
echo "$PROBE"
grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$PROBE"
echo "[AGENT_PROGRESS] capture_sd_mount_diagnostics port=$PORT_S3"
PORT_S3="$PORT_S3" .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os, time, serial
port=os.environ['PORT_S3']
end=time.monotonic()+95
seen_sd=0
seen_soak=0
with serial.Serial(port=port, baudrate=115200, timeout=1) as dev:
    try:
        dev.dtr=False
        dev.rts=False
    except Exception:
        pass
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        raw=dev.readline()
        if not raw:
            continue
        line=raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').rstrip()
        if 'stage27_sd' in line:
            print(line, flush=True)
            seen_sd += 1
        elif 'Stage27 real-input runtime' in line or 'Stage27 soak boot' in line:
            print(line, flush=True)
        elif 'soak_v=2 ' in line and seen_soak < 3:
            print(line, flush=True)
            seen_soak += 1
print(f'[AGENT_PROGRESS] sd_diag_lines={seen_sd} soak_samples={seen_soak}', flush=True)
if seen_sd == 0:
    raise SystemExit('No stage27_sd diagnostics captured')
PY
test -z "$(git status --short)"
